results.title: Where your tax shilling goes
results.summary: A short scroll through how PAYE and VAT feed the national budget — and what counties receive.
results.description: A short scroll through how PAYE and VAT feed the national budget — and what counties receive.

slides.text: Every PAYE deduction is a claim on tomorrow’s classrooms, clinics, and roads.
National government keeps some revenue; counties get a share via the Division of Revenue.
County governments typically receive around this share of nationally raised revenue after equitable allocation.

results.title: The Finance Bill in plain words
results.summary: What Kenya’s annual Finance Bill changes — tax rates, exemptions, and why public hearings matter.
results.description: What Kenya’s annual Finance Bill changes — tax rates, exemptions, and why public hearings matter.

slides.text: The Finance Bill is how Parliament updates tax law for the next fiscal year.
Citizens can submit memoranda before MPs vote — your feedback is part of the process.

results.title: From Budget Day to your ward
results.summary: Follow the path from the Budget Policy Statement to projects that show up in your county CIDP.
results.description: Follow the path from the Budget Policy Statement to projects that show up in your county CIDP.

slides.text: National priorities start in the Budget Policy Statement (BPS).
County Fiscal Strategy Papers (CFSP) and CIDPs translate those priorities into local plans.
